dogecoin.text:
Not financial advice, I don't look at charts for a living. 

There are $Doge coin millionaires going on TV, it's not hard to see we're in the euphoria phase. All of my friends and family frequently call me about crypto. 

It's coming soon if it's not this one.

Sometimes people need to lose their money to learn. I just hope it doesn't bring bad regulation to us all. 

$DOGE

#Cardano is on its way to becoming a household name. I spend a lot of time talking to locals in Florida. 

$ADA is in many people's portfolios now, followed by $BTC, $ETH, and $DOGE. $DOGE being number one.

Anecdotally #Cardano is going mainstream. @SnoopDogg will help.
